name: Warped Weather
description: An unnatural magical storm appears in the area with a crack of thunder and lightning.
disable: DC 13 Arcana , DC 13 Nature , DC 13 Occultism , or DC 13 Religion (all trained) to overcome the magical anomaly, or DC 16 Athletics , DC 16 Survival , or DC 16 Thievery to destabilize the hazard's center point; two total successes are required to disable the hazard.
routine: (3 actions) The hazard makes three ranged Strikes against PCs, selecting different targets if possible, beginning with those closest to the hazard's center.

offensiveAbilities.name: Electric Flash
offensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger A PC enters the area

Effect With a flash of light, the area crackles with electricity, and it begins to rain. The triggering creature is dealt (1d6+2) Electricity Damage damage (Basic DC 16 Reflex Saving Throw save). On a critical failure, that creature is additionally Dazzled for 1 round. The hazard then rolls initiative.
